rationale: All three lenses ran. Two items need a human decision: AC3 (readability) is only partially met because the agreed Summary baseline uses 11px/12px text that a diff cannot show is readable, and the new sessionTypography.ts adds arbitrary Tailwind values that the styling guide forbids (though they mirror the restored MetricCard classes). Deferred (4): pre-existing formatDuration(0) renders '—' so a first dispatch reads '— into session'; 999.5-999.99ms rounds to '1000ms'; 70px duration column could be tight for long strings like '10mo 3w 4d'; typography constants duplicate MetricCard classes. Dismissed (9): formatDuration style nits (variable named window, defensive Math.max, map with side effect), zero inner units shown by design, three-unit truncation by design, removal of the inner Timeline heading (the AnalyticsWidget title 'Timeline' remains), cn() to template string in MetricCard (restores the pre-MR code), and similar.

business_review.item: Typography follows the design system / consistent font family, sizes, weights across analytics widgets
business_review.notes: Shared AnalyticsWidget, MetricCard and BarChartWidget restored to pre-MR 2248 classes; MetricCard value is a single text-lg; Session Details tiles use constants that mirror MetricCard.

business_review.item: Consistent heading, label and value styling (clear hierarchy)
business_review.notes: Title 18px, description 14px, label 11px uppercase, value 18px across MetricCard users and Session timeline tiles.

business_review.item: Readable text with appropriate contrast and spacing
business_review.notes: Labels, captions and descriptions are 11px and timeline rows 12px (the agreed Summary baseline, chosen to avoid oversized numbers). The click-a-step hint now uses text-quaternary (lower contrast than the former text-secondary). Readability and contrast cannot be proven from the diff; needs a browser check.
Session metric grids share gap-3 / max-sm:gap-2; timeline label column is minmax(120px,180px).

business_review.item: Proper hierarchy at supported viewports; no clipping, overlap or truncation
business_review.notes: Top row stacks below lg and the label column can shrink, but no browser or viewport verification is recorded; the fixed 70px duration column may be narrow for the longest new duration strings.

business_review.item: Do not change views outside CLI Analytics typography (revert MR 2248 shared-component changes)
business_review.notes: Shared components match pre-MR classes except the one agreed MetricCard value change (text-lg, no sm:text-xl), which also affects non-CLI MetricCard users such as Insights, Leaderboard and Schedulers.

business_review.item: formatDuration shows d/h/m at 24h, w/d/h at 7d, mo/w/d at 30d for all CLI Analytics
business_review.notes: Unit table with a three-unit window; boundary samples 24h, 1w, 1mo, 127h50m3s verified.

standards_review.notes: Both commit subjects match 'EPMCDME-16832: Capital sentence'; branch is EPMCDME-16832_scope-typography-to-session-details.

styling-guide.md forbids arbitrary Tailwind values. New sessionTypography.ts adds text-[11px] and tracking-[0.03em]. The same classes already exist in MetricCard (pre-MR), BarChartWidget caption was restored from pre-MR.
Class-name and formatting changes only; no HTML sinks, redirects, secrets or config.

findings.title: New arbitrary Tailwind values conflict with the styling guide
findings.problem: SESSION_STAT_LABEL_CLASS uses text-[11px] and tracking-[0.03em], which the styling guide bans, in a newly added file.
findings.impact: Adds new guide violations to the PR. Using only guide-compliant tokens (e.g. text-h5 at 12px) would change the visual size and break parity with the MetricCard labels the user asked to match.
findings.recommendation: Decide: keep exact parity with MetricCard (accept arbitrary values, same as the pre-MR MetricCard) or switch to a design token and accept a 1px size difference.

findings.title: Readability AC is only partially met and unverified
findings.problem: The agreed baseline puts labels and captions at 11px and timeline rows at 12px, and the hint text colour moved from text-secondary to text-quaternary. AC3 (readable text, appropriate contrast) cannot be confirmed from the diff and no viewport check is recorded.
findings.impact: Small low-contrast text may still be judged hard to read by the ticket reviewer, while larger sizes were rejected by the user as too big.
findings.recommendation: Verify in the browser at desktop and narrow widths. If the hint looks faint, restore text-secondary; otherwise accept the baseline and note it in the MR.
